categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Mobile viewport meta present on all pages
Meta charset declared on all pages

findings.title: No robots.txt
findings.description: No /robots.txt file in dist/ or public/. Search engines have no crawling directives, no sitemap pointer, and no AI crawler guidance.
findings.recommendation: Create robots.txt at site root with sitemap pointer, crawl-delay, and GPTBot/Claude-Web directives.

findings.title: No sitemap.xml
findings.description: No XML sitemap found. 23 pages must be discovered organically via internal links.
findings.recommendation: Generate sitemap.xml listing all 23 pages with lastmod dates.

findings.title: No canonical URLs
findings.description: 0 of 23 pages have a canonical link tag. Duplicate content risk from URL variants when deployed.
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing canonical tags to BaseLayout.

findings.title: Meta refresh redirects instead of 301
findings.description: /qipao/ and /tang/ use meta http-equiv='refresh' redirects which search engines handle poorly for SEO value transfer.
findings.recommendation: Replace with proper 301 redirects at the server or Astro config level.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage (1,373 words), /hanfu/ (1,020), /plan-trip/ (1,233) have solid content depth
Writing quality is clear, engaging, and accessible for international audiences
FAQ content is well-structured with substantive answers

findings.title: 14 thin content pages below 300 words
findings.description: 17 of 21 content pages fail minimum word count quality gates. Pages like /blog/ (30 words), /gallery/ (44), /compare/ (45), and /quiz/ (48) are effectively empty.
findings.recommendation: Expand thin pages to meet quality gates: 800 words for feature pages, 500-600 for secondary pages, 800 for FAQ.

findings.title: Zero E-E-A-T signals
findings.description: No author attribution, no about page, no citations, no publication dates on any page. Google's quality raters and AI models both penalize this.
findings.recommendation: Create /about/ page with author bios. Add publication dates and author bylines to content pages. Cite authoritative sources for historical claims.

findings.title: Empty blog
findings.description: Blog page has 30 words and zero posts. This is the primary channel for long-tail keyword coverage.
findings.recommendation: Publish 5 foundational posts in month 1, then maintain 1-2 posts per week.

findings.title: Strategic pivot from educational to travel guide
findings.description: SITE-PLAN targeted an educational encyclopedia of Chinese traditional clothing. The built site is travel-focused. This changes keyword targeting and audience.
findings.recommendation: Clarify strategy. If travel-focused, optimize titles and meta for travel-intent keywords. If educational, reduce travel language and add educational depth.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title tags and meta descriptions present on all content pages
Internal navigation links exist in header and footer

findings.title: No Open Graph or Twitter Card tags
findings.description: Zero social meta tags on any page. Social shares display bare URLs with no preview image, title, or description.
findings.recommendation: Add OG and Twitter Card tags to BaseLayout with dynamic per-page values.

findings.title: Homepage H1 lacks primary keyword
findings.description: H1 is 'Wear China's History on Your Journey' — the primary keyword 'Chinese Traditional Wear' does not appear anywhere in the heading hierarchy.
findings.recommendation: Change H1 to 'Chinese Traditional Wear Through the Ages' or similar keyword-inclusive variant.

findings.title: 11 of 15 titles exceed 60-char SERP limit
findings.description: Most titles will be truncated in Google search results, losing the brand name and potentially critical keywords.
findings.recommendation: Shorten titles to 50-60 characters while preserving primary keywords near the beginning.

findings.title: Garbled UTF-8 in meta descriptions
findings.description: /dynasties/ and /accessories/ meta descriptions contain garbled characters. Likely an encoding issue in source Astro components.
findings.recommendation: Fix encoding in source, verify with build output.

findings.title: No schema markup on any page
findings.description: Zero JSON-LD blocks, zero microdata, zero RDFa across all 23 pages. Missing Organization, FAQPage, Article, BreadcrumbList, and WebSite schemas.
findings.recommendation: Implement Organization and WebSite on homepage, FAQPage on FAQ content, Article on all content pages, BreadcrumbList on all pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Astro SSG generates pure HTML with minimal JS

findings.title: Google Fonts render-blocking
findings.description: Outfit and Noto Serif SC loaded from Google Fonts CDN without font-display: swap. Blocks text rendering and causes CLS.
findings.recommendation: Self-host fonts or add display=swap parameter to font URLs.

findings.title: All images externally hotlinked
findings.description: All images served from images.unsplash.com with no CDN control over caching, format, or performance.
findings.recommendation: Self-host critical images with WebP/AVIF conversion. Use srcset for responsive loading.

findings.title: No explicit image dimensions
findings.description: Missing width/height attributes on most img tags causing CLS risk.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit width and height to all img elements.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Semantic HTML structure (header, nav, main, section, footer)
Good heading hierarchy for AI parsing
FAQ content exists for featured-snippet eligibility

findings.title: No AI crawler directives
findings.description: No robots.txt exists, so no GPTBot, Claude-Web, or PerplexityBot directives. No /llms.txt endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Add robots.txt with explicit AI crawler directives. Create /llms.txt with structured content summary.

findings.title: Missing author and date signals
findings.description: AI models prioritize content with clear authorship and publication dates. Zero such signals on this site.
findings.recommendation: Add author attribution and publication dates to all content pages.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Descriptive alt text on homepage hero and category images
Correct loading strategy (eager for hero, lazy for others)

findings.title: All images externally hotlinked
findings.description: All 20 images on homepage served from images.unsplash.com. No format optimization, no caching control, no guaranteed uptime.
findings.recommendation: Self-host key images. Use picture element with WebP/AVIF sources.

findings.title: Gallery section has duplicate alt text
findings.description: All 6 gallery images have identical alt text despite showing different locations.
findings.recommendation: Give each gallery image a unique, descriptive alt text.

findings.title: No responsive images
findings.description: No srcset or sizes attributes on any image. Mobile users download desktop-resolution images.
findings.recommendation: Add srcset with 2-3 breakpoints and sizes attribute.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add schema markup (Organization, WebSite, FAQPage, Article, BreadcrumbList)
Add canonical URLs to all pages
Replace meta refresh redirects with 301 redirects
Add Open Graph and Twitter Card tags to BaseLayout

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Expand 14 thin content pages to meet quality gates
Add author attribution and publication dates
Fix garbled UTF-8 encoding in meta descriptions
Shorten title tags to 50-60 character range
